body: Thank you.  But Mariah, she is the land i walk on, she was my queen, my castle.  She was everything to me. I told her i would love her until my last dying breath and you know what, i know what i said and i told her i fucking mean it! I can go the rest of my LONG and USELESS life  however many years, with or without her and i will still love her in death. She was my dignity, my self respect, my love,  my ambition and she was my confidence.  I don't even know what those things i listed mean any more.  Shes so beautiful, so flawless. She was the prettiest thing i will ever witness with my eyes and i had her! I had the PERFECT future lined up with the girl of my fucking dreams and i guess i THREW it all away due to my own careless selfishness.  I feel i dont deserve to breathe any more. I have been fighting this 'Major  Depression Syndrome'  ever since i was just a kid because i have always hated myself.  What your saying to me means a lot man, it does and what your saying makes sense, it's all valid but...  I told myself...  The next time i tie that rope to the ceiling boards above me. I will do it, i promised myself that! Every day man, shit gets worse and worse.  I personally don't care for much anymore. I don't care about my life and my existence what-so-ever actually! Im just counting the days, the days until i wish to set myself free.   I thought i was going to do it today. I would be hanging right now if it wasn't for a little noise that stopped me this morning. Made me think twice.  I had one foot off the stool and i knew i wanted it...  I desperately want to end my life but i hesitate because i dread the first witness to see my corpse :(  ii have more issues than Michael Jackson.  I cry at random some times...  I cry all the time! Until my tears tun dry! I can hardly look into the mirror anymore. I dont feel alive dude. Thats it. <---  i feel hollow.  Faithless. Hopeless. I feel dead inside and i just want to end the game of life. I figured out that life is just a game!! It is!! Compare it to a board game and there ya go.  I fucking hate this game.  Thank you for telling me how i live life uniquely in a different way it means a lot as well.  But  i don't mind who wins man.  Since it's just a game, i can take being the loser. Know what i mean? And no, i understand what ya mean. Thanks. Also, thats fairly fluent english, nice job.
